---
title: "Transport Checklist"
---

Complete this checklist prior to intra-hospital transport or procedures.

## Pre-Transport

```{ojs}
pre_items = [
  "EVD leveled at tragus",
  "Clamp status confirmed",
  "EVD setting verified",
  "ICP value reviewed",
  "Waveform assessed",
  "CSF output reviewed",
  "Tubing secured",
  "System integrity maintained"
]
viewof pre_checked = Inputs.checkbox(pre_items, {label: ""})
```

## During Transport

```{ojs}
during_items = [
  "ICP monitoring maintained",
  "Head position maintained",
  "Drain status appropriate"
]
viewof during_checked = Inputs.checkbox(during_items, {label: ""})
```

## Readiness Status

```{ojs}
total = pre_items.length + during_items.length
completed = pre_checked.length + during_checked.length

html`<div style="padding:15px;border-radius:10px;
  background:${completed === total ? '#e8f5e9' : '#fdecea'};
  border-left:6px solid ${completed === total ? '#27ae60' : '#e74c3c'};">
  ${completed === total
    ? "✅ Ready for Transport"
    : `⚠️ ${total - completed} item(s) remaining`}
</div>`
```

## Key Reference

**Enhancing Safety in Intrahospital Transport of Patients With External Ventricular Drains Through Simulation-Based Training.**
Bharadwaj MS, Abu-Alya A, Fochs A, Liau C, McGlennen KM, Ishimoto L, Bjurstrom M, Guo S, Khadka S, Teske T, Vu TT, Lele AV.
J Neurosurg Anesthesiol. 2025 Oct 31. doi: 10.1097/ANA.0000000000001067.
